decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 27th November 2006 the erection of a single storey side and rear extension to the back of the house with a depth of 8.6m along the north boundary of the site, a depth of 3.8m from rear wall of original addition, set back of 2m from south boundary, and height of 2.6m, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because it's volume would not exceed 50 cubic metres, would not exceed 4m in height, and not result in the coverage of the site of more than 50 square metres (excluding coverage of original house).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a proposed single storey side and rear extension to house
